review.why: Lists Google Slides API methods for the gws CLI; auth and safety rules sit in a separate shared skill.
review.summary: Generated reference for the gws slides command: presentations batchUpdate, create, get and pages, with a pointer to inspect methods through gws schema. It does not describe how to build a deck, and defers authentication and security rules to another skill.
strengths: Shows how to discover methods and parameters with gws schema
Notes that a failed batchUpdate request applies nothing
cautions: Needs the gws CLI and Google authentication from a shared skill not included here
API listing only: no workflow for designing slides
Auto-generated, so it adds little to the CLI's own help
